title: Adjustment Parts on Alignment Work Orders — Alignment Services & Plans Plan Desk Pricing Policy
content:
**Alignment Services & Plans — pricing of adjustment parts on a plan's latest work order.**

A store that performs an alignment on a plan vehicle lists on the work order, as its parts charge, the adjustment parts it installed at their list price. The plan desk then prices the parts of the plan's latest work order — the alignment work order with the latest work-order date on the plan.

For the latest work order of a plan whose adjustment parts the plan desk prices under this policy, and only for such a work order, the parts charge is the amount this policy prices from the adjustment parts the store listed on it (shims, cam bolt kits, adjustment sleeves and eccentric bushings, the parts every line charges separately), and the line's steering angle sensor reset charge is added to it. A work order on which the vehicle requires a recalibration carries any of the separately charged adjustment parts the vehicle needed, plus the line's steering angle sensor reset charge, plus the line's recalibration charge, under the general alignment service terms, and so does every other work order.

### Which work order
| Work order on the plan | Priced under this policy? |
|---|---|
| The alignment work order with the latest work-order date, vehicle requiring no recalibration | Yes |
| The latest work order, vehicle requiring a recalibration | No — general terms |
| Any earlier work order | No — general terms |

## Tool reference: `price_work_order_parts_2c1ce050`

**What it does.** Sets the parts charge of an alignment work order on a plan: it replaces the figure the store listed with the parts amount the customer is charged for the work order. On success the work order shows the parts charge given on the ticket; its labor, service basis, date, odometer and alignment type are left as they are.

**Invocation.** Agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `price_work_order_parts_2c1ce050`, then calls it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `alignment_plan_id` | reference number of the alignment plan the work order is posted on, from the alignment plan lookup | text |
| `alignment_event_id` | reference number of the alignment work order (an alignment performed entry on the plan), from the plan's alignment activity lookup | text |
| `parts_charge` | parts charged on the work order | USD, non-negative, 2 decimal places; rounded to the nearest cent by the tool when more digits are given; 0.00 when no parts are charged |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `alignment_plan_id`, `alignment_event_id`, `parts_charge` (the parts amount now booked, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status` with the text `parts_priced`, confirming the work order now carries its parts charge. No error return is defined for this tool.
